alt_title: India 118/0 in 6 Overs: A T20I Powerplay Record
description: India made 118 for 0 in the six-over powerplay against New Zealand in Wellington on 27 October 2026: a T20I record, per ESPNcricinfo. Chasing 199, the overs went 26, 17, 21, 20, 16 and 18.
New Zealand, batting first on the same ground, made 58 for 1 in their powerplay, and needed 12 overs to pass 118 (113 after 11 overs, 123 after 12).
The old marks: Romania 116/0 against Serbia (2021, a chase won in 5.4 overs, so not a full powerplay) and Australia 113/1 against Scotland (2024).

Abhishek Sharma made 113 off 38 balls (his hundred came off 35), and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi 45 off 19. The openers put on 133. India won by six wickets with 40 balls to spare and lead the five-match series 3-0.
source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard, overs comparison and match report, New Zealand vs India, 3rd T20I, Wellington, 27 Oct 2026; scorecard cross-checked on BCCI.tv. Earlier marks: ESPNcricinfo scorecards, Romania vs Serbia (26 Jun 2021) and Scotland vs Australia (4 Sep 2024). Read 27 Oct 2026.
